note: The per-unit path stops allocating. Measured against the decomposition taken 40 minutes earlier, with the empty-map baseline re-flown to prove the device had not moved.
theChange: three allocations per entity per frame removed: gtaToEngine's coordinate array, project's returned point, and the hit rect. `projectInto(x, y, z, out)` takes three numbers and writes into a point the layer owns; the hit rects are pooled and their records reused; the `[...chipAreas, ...areas]` concatenation that copied every rect every frame went with them.
why: the decomposition said the cost was not the drawing — `sym:units` 4.1 ms for 150 units, and hiding 110 of the marks moved it 0.1 ms — so what dominates is what runs for EVERY unit whether or not it draws, ~190 times a frame at ~50 fps on a phone's collector.

control.reading: the empty map is untouched by any of this (it has no units), so it is the check that the device is in the same state. 20.03-20.43 before, 20.25 after.

board.conditions: 150 units, ~40 calls, fleet loaded (unitsAsModels 150, draws 3571), 82/80 marks drawn, css 360x609 in both

reading.sym:units: 4.04 -> 1.62 ms, -60 %, at the same mark count. The allocation WAS the cost, which is what the decomposition predicted and what three earlier drawing-side levers had each failed to move.
reading.cpu: 11.04 -> 7.86 ms of body, -3.2 — more than sym:units alone, because the same allocations were being made for calls (`sym:calls`) and because the concatenation went too.
reading.frame: 26.30 -> 23.81 ms, -2.5. The board's cost OVER the empty map falls from +6.1 to +3.6 ms — nearly halved — while p50 stays at 18 and p95 drops 50 -> 38, which is the shape of a tail losing its collector pauses rather than a floor moving.
reading.whatDidNotMove: p50, at 18 ms in both. Half the frames were already landing on one display interval and still do; what this bought is the other half.

alsoFixed: the boot flash the operator caught: the mark rule asked whether a car was drawn RIGHT NOW, which at startup is no for every unit, so the console opened with 150 chevrons and dropped 110 a second later. `willDraw` answers whether a car is COMING — a model in flight counts, only a unit that names none or names one this build cannot supply keeps a mark. Confirmed on the device in this session: marksHidden read 109 while unitsAsModels was still 0.
owed: nothing here, but the next term is unchanged and named: the empty map is 20.2 ms of which 201/9's sweep priced the post chain at 7.7 and the world at 3.8. Every board-side lever now sums to +3.6.
